description: Replacement of one existing first floor rear window, one existing ground floor rear door and two existing ground floor rear windows with one first floor rear single window and one ground floor rear double window to the house.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (001; 002; 003C; 004; 005  Received:  01 February 2023) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The rear wall voids that would result from the removal of the existing rear door and windows hereby approved shall be infilled with matching white painted rendered wall (rear first floor wall) and white painted brick wall with a matching brick course and mortar (rear ground floor wall).
